definitions.event_lines: nonempty lines beginning with a bullet, numbered item, or YYYY-MM-DD
definitions.complex: highest ceil(10% of eligible population) complexity scores; ties by S/O characters then ID
definitions.length_strata: remaining patients ranked by S/O character count: bottom quarter, middle half, top quarter
definitions.sampling: equal counts; deterministic boundary/extreme anchors plus seeded random remainder
definitions.label_use: reference action count and reference judgeability are selection/projection features only
